purpose: Frozen import surface that C Note vendors and resolves in its no-network sandbox. Pinned so the academic Economics gallery builds against a stable contract while Economoist internals evolve.
scope_note: Every economic property here is a genuine unqualified SMT green: proven at the SMT tier by cvc5 over the reals, with zero fuzz samples and no contract assumption in its discharge. This is the differentiator from Shoals, whose composite finance greens are proven_modulo_fuzz_validated_contract. The verdicts below are all composite_verdict proven. Three boundaries are held out and must be stated with equal weight wherever a green is shown: limit and fixed-point results (convergence to stationarity, the unique Bellman fixed point) need induction and are out; the general state dimension is held out alongside them (the structural greens are the n equals two instance, mirrored to three, not the all-n theorem); and the proofs are over the reals (arith_model real), not f32 float behavior.
eval_import_boundary: prove resolves these module imports, so the proven properties are reachable and the proof surface is guaranteed. eval does not yet resolve imports for standalone files, so a C Note template that needs to eval a model inlines its single-expression body until eval-side import resolution lands. The proof surface this manifest freezes is not blocked by the eval boundary.
